known_limitations: Reference implementation assumes a predominantly translating moving foreground within the supplied crop.
Foreground support is estimated from temporal median background difference and can be contaminated by illumination/compression changes.
Leading-edge support is a registration constraint, not a claim that the edge is literally an instantaneous exposure sample.
Dense optical-flow warping interpolates observed samples and remains derived evidence.
The latent multi-frame variant is a conservative flow-aligned robust estimate plus supported-pixel edge restoration, not generative inpainting.
